content_variants.text:
“Al-Fath Al-Mubin” bombardment | Family of four members including two children killed in Awrem Al-Kubra in western countryside of Aleppo

Aleppo province: A whole family of four members: father, mother and two little girls, were killed, due to shells fell on their house in the artillery shelling of factions of “Al-Fath Al-Mubin” operations room, yesterday, on Awrem Al-Kubra town within regime-held areas in the western countryside of Aleppo.
“Putin-Erdogan” area witnessed in the early hours of this morning, an exchanged artillery shelling between regime forces and factions of “Al-Fath Al-Mubin” operations room, where regime forces fired heavy artillery shells on Al-Fatirah, Fuleyfel and Safouhen villages in Jabal Al-ZAwiyah in the southern countryside of Idlib and Al-Ankawi village in Sahil Al-Ghab in the western countryside of Hama.
In contrast, faction of “Al-Fath Al-Mubin” targeted positions of regime forces in Al-Dar Al-Kabirah and Al-Malajah in the southern countryside of Idlib. No causalities were reported.
Moreover, frontlines of Al-Masharea in Sahil Al-Ghab in the western countryside of Hama and Kabanah in Jabal Al-Akrad in the northern countryside of Latakia, witnessed an exchange of artillery shelling between regime forces and factions. No causalities were reported.
